create_stylemixing_widget: create a StyleMixingWidget instance by passing a viz object with result and args attributes
call_stylemixing_widget: call the StyleMixingWidget to render the stylemix UI with seed input and layer enable checkboxes
set_stylemix_seed: set the seed value on a StyleMixingWidget to control random style mixing behavior
toggle_stylemix_enables: toggle individual layer enable flags in the enables list to select which layers to style mix
reset_stylemix_widget: click the Reset button to restore seed to default, disable animation, and clear all layer enables
